newsitem.title: UK: BoF sells marks at 3.4300 French francs - dealers.
newsitem.headline: BoF sells marks at 3.4300 French francs - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of France sold marks for French francs at 3.4300 in early European trading, dealers said. The French central bank has been in the market of late in an attempt to keep the French franc above its old ERM floor of 3.4305 per mark, they added.
Mark/Paris spiked up to 3.4315 overnight but fell back and a brief foray above 3.43 in early European prompted the central bank action.
At 0713 GMT it was trading at 3.4290/95.
